## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 jun 2026 - 18 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Isidro Erazo_, 28 jun 2026, 1/5: "These people won't let you cancel the year subscription. looks like the company needs money"
            2. _Jack Leonard_, 20 ago 2026, 2/5: "Not great for strength/hypertrophy. This app is so close to being amazing, all it needs is the ability to properly interact with the 'AI' to create proper workouts for muscle growth. Other reviews have pointed out the specific deficiencies for strength training. It is probably good if you want to lose weight (i.e. low weights, high reps, repeated for the same muscles day after day), and the UI is generally good too. It is overpriced but I get the subscription for free with my bank."
            3. _Berkut 0001_, 18 sept 2026, 4/5: "noice but expensive"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 3 may 2026 - 17 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Juan Sebastián Sánchez_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "Used to like the app but since the latest update is buggy af. Can't trust it for runs as it will randomly change the distances I've run or just skip intervals altogether"
            2. _Mark Campbell-Smith_, 3 may 2026, 1/5: "app crashing when starting a workout. unusable at the moment"
            3. _Simone Rinaldi_, 16 jun 2026, 5/5: "Ottima, app ben fatta. Anche se non dimenticatevi che per avere risultati, abbinata all'app, ci vuole COSTANZA! Edit: sono quasi alla 40esima settimana di workout e le cose vanno a meraviglia, grazie! edit. l'app va in crash al momento di iniziare il workout. app going in crash when I try to open day's workout, pls resolve"
<!--/ir-theme-->
